name: Dhairyashil
reason: Good Marathi name (Dhairyasheel); meaning should say courage/fortitude.

name: Dinkar
reason: Common auspicious boy's name, epithet of the sun; meaning correct.

name: Milind
reason: Used for boys in Maharashtra; milinda is a honey-bee. Also name of Indo-Greek king Menander in Buddhist texts, but common as given name.

name: Pradnesh
reason: Regional spelling of Prajñeśa, lord of wisdom; used for boys.

name: Sandesh
reason: Used as a boy's name in Maharashtra and Gujarat; sandeśa means message.

name: Shripad
reason: Valid name; meaning wording imprecise (Shripada Shrivallabha is regarded as an early Dattatreya incarnation).

fix.meaning_en: Revered feet (of a master or deity); also the name of Shripada Shrivallabha, regarded as an early Dattatreya avatar.

name: Suhas
reason: Common boy's name; su + hāsa, pleasant smile.
